    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/160919119/0.148.0</id>
    <updated>2026-10-19T12:25:19Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/releases/tag/0.148.0"/>
    <title>0.148.0</title>
    <content type="html"><p>Defaults for omitted <code>Query</code>, <code>Header</code>, <code>Cookie</code>, and <code>Form</code> parameters and model fields are no longer treated as user input. Defaults are not validated unless <code>validate_default=True</code> is enabled. If you rely on validators running for omitted values, enable default validation with <code>Field(validate_default=True)</code> for model fields or, for example, <code>Query(validate_default=True)</code> for individual parameters. <code>Body(validate_default=True)</code> is now honored too.</p>
<p>For parameter models, applying a default no longer marks a field as explicitly set, so <code>model_dump(exclude_unset=True)</code> excludes it. Default factories run once, and validation errors no longer include injected defaults in <code>input</code>.</p>
<p>Omitted boolean form fields still become <code>False</code> and count as explicitly set.</p>
<h3>Breaking Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>🐛 Fix default handling for request parameters and models. PR <a href="https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/pull/16527" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/fastapi/fastapi/pull/16527/hovercard">#16527</a> by <a href="https://github.com/tiangolo">@tiangolo</a>.</li>
</ul></content>

  <entry>
    <id>tag:github.com,2008:Repository/160919119/0.147.0</id>
    <updated>2026-10-19T09:48:41Z</updated>
    <link rel="alternate" type="text/html" href="https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/releases/tag/0.147.0"/>
    <title>0.147.0</title>
    <content type="html"><p>Omitted <code>bool</code> and <code>bool | None</code> form fields are now interpreted as <code>False</code>, matching unchecked HTML checkboxes. This applies to individual <code>Form</code> parameters and form models, including required fields and fields with defaults of <code>True</code> or <code>None</code>. The inferred value is considered explicitly set, including in <code>model_dump(exclude_unset=True)</code>.</p>
<p>JSON requests and direct Pydantic validation are unchanged. See <a href="https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/tutorial/request-forms/#boolean-form-fields" rel="nofollow">Boolean Form Fields</a>.</p>
<h3>Breaking Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>🐛 Treat omitted boolean form fields as False. PR <a href="https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/pull/16523" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/fastapi/fastapi/pull/16523/hovercard">#16523</a> by <a href="https://github.com/tiangolo">@tiangolo</a>.</li>
</ul>
<h3>Internal</h3>
<ul>
<li>✅ Add tests for parameter defaults, nullability, and browser form behavior. PR <a href="https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/pull/14829" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/fastapi/fastapi/pull/14829/hovercard">#14829</a> by <a href="https://github.com/YuriiMotov">@YuriiMotov</a>.</li>
</ul></content>

    <title>0.146.0</title>
    <content type="html"><p>The <code>root_path</code> parameter in <code>FastAPI()</code> is deprecated. Configure the server with <code>fastapi run --root-path /api/v1</code> instead.</p>
<h3>Breaking Changes</h3>
<ul>
<li>🗑️ Deprecate the <code>root_path</code> parameter in <code>FastAPI</code>. PR <a href="https://github.com/fastapi/fastapi/pull/16520" data-hovercard-type="pull_request" data-hovercard-url="/fastapi/fastapi/pull/16520/hovercard">#16520</a> by <a href="https://github.com/tiangolo">@tiangolo</a>.</li>
</ul></content>
